goal: Decide whether a narrowly bounded offline mechanism may consume exact human comment adjudications, or pause the source route, without granting real acquisition or weakening active capability stops.
scope: Read current formal semantics decision/PRD, derived Leader manual review, accepted candidate/freeze and first-party schema only. Exact manual review covers two existing body/line/rule hits; neighboring server-use fields, dependencies and capability reachability remain unreviewed. Do not follow private/source pointers.

Return explicit APPROVED/REVISE/PAUSE and write formal decision in product knowledge base, update affected PRD/INDEX/decision log/source attribution. Chats alone are insufficient. Product repository source and frozen documents remain unchanged in this decision task; report formal hashes for separate sync.

Determine whether one next offline first-party bounded design/implementation task is warranted for authentic exact-bound human review evidence, or PAUSE if it requires arbitrary exceptions, broadened source scope or unnecessary additional investment. Specify only one next task and acceptance/stop conditions, no continuous development.

If approving a mechanism, require explicit independently trusted authority/report identity and full source/body/line/rule/occurrence binding with unambiguous old/new line hash domains. Missing, extra, altered, duplicate, wrong-object or conflicting evidence must fail closed; forbidden/unresolved/pending continue stopping. New comment occurrences cannot inherit clearance. Active/uncertain deny, lexical/unsupported/file-safety gates must remain hard regardless of review.

Decide how any justified narrow clearance is represented separately from source/runtime/license/P0/reachability approval. No external wrapper bypass, edited old terminal, blanket comment ignoring or global token exemptions; preserve original analysis and durable review provenance. Existing frozen v6 has no consumption API and remains immutable.

Define self-authored offline regression matrix retaining all158existingtests plus evidence-binding/tamper/nontransferability/priority/no-successor cases, deterministic double evidence and independent Leader acceptance before any separate new freeze/real authorization. No use of actual header content as fixture.
out_of_scope: No real source/PRIVATE/body/metadata/API/scannercontext reads, pointer traversal, web/network or thirdparty acquisition/dependencies. No code/tool/freeze/oldrun/App changes, no live transport/input creation/real fetch permission.

No claim current comment decision clears adjacent fields/runtime/API scope or source closure/adoption, no new acquisition authorization or reuse of historical authorization, no CP2/CP3/Alpha approval.
acceptance: Formal APPROVED/REVISE/PAUSE decision and relevant product documents exist with clear authority/next-task scope or pause, exact hash-bound review findings attributed accurately.
Decision explicitly preserves separate future Leader acceptance/freeze and fresh user acquisition approval; no realsource execution or access required for PM.
evidence_required: RESULT APPROVED/REVISE/PAUSE; formal changedpaths/hashes and rationale, precise nextsingle task/acceptance/stops or pause; contradictions and unresolved issues. Notify Leader then stop.
stop_conditions: Need actual source/otherfile review, relaxed scope/privacy/capability/checkpoint, arbitrary preprocessor or review waiver: PAUSE/return decision, do not execute expansion.
Existing formaldocuments or ownership unclear: report instead of overwriting unknown changes.
